stem:
The bar graph shows the flavors of gum bought yesterday by the customers at a store. Each customer bought only 1 flavor of gum.

Which statement is NOT supported by the data displayed in the bar graph?

options.label: F
options.text: The same number of customers bought peppermint as the number of customers who bought cinnamon.

options.label: H
options.text: There were 120 customers who bought gum yesterday.

options.label: J
options.text: There were 2.5 times as many customers who bought spearmint as customers who bought peppermint.

visual_elements: Bar graph titled 'Gum Flavors Bought' with y-axis labeled 'Number of Customers' showing bars at Spearmint=50, Peppermint=20, Watermelon=30, Cinnamon=20
